Assessment of BA.evidence_source: The section describes use of the Authentic Pride subscale of the Body and Appearance Self-Conscious Emotions Scale (BASES; Castonguay, Sabiston, Crocker, & Mack, 2014).

section_summary.extract_value: This section details the measurement of body pride using the Authentic Pride subscale of the Body and Appearance Self-Conscious Emotions Scale (BASES), a 6-item scale with items rated 1 (never) to 5 (always) and scored by averaging items. It reports good psychometric support for BASES from Castonguay et al. (2014) and an ordinal coefficient of .97 for the Authentic Pride subscale in the present study. The section does not report sample characteristics, country, BMI assessment, body appreciation (BAS/BAS-2), survey method, or study numbering.
section_summary.evidence_source: Quoted sentences: "To measure body pride, we used the Authentic Pride subscale of the Body and Appearance Self-Conscious Emotions Scale (BASES; Castonguay, Sabiston, Crocker, & Mack, 2014)." "This is a 6-item measure that characterises body pride as personal appearance-related achievements and behaviours (sample item: 'I am proud of my appearance efforts'). Items for this subscale were rated on a 5-point scale, ranging from 1 (never) to 5 (always). The scale is scored by calculating the mean of all 6 items and higher scores reflect greater body pride." "In the present study, ordinal coefficient  for the Authentic Pride subscale was .97."
